chunks: The child belongs to the lawful bed, and for the adulterer is the stone.

key_terms.اَلْحَجَرُ: the stone; an expression of deprivation and denial of claim
key_terms.اَلْعَاهِرِ: the adulterer; the fornicator who has no legal claim to the child
key_terms.اَلْوَلَدُ: the child; the offspring whose lineage is being legally assigned
key_terms.لِلْفِرَاشِ: to the bed; meaning the lawful marital bed and legal paternity context

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "the child belongs to the bed" mean in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition establishes the principle that a child is legally attributed to the marital bed, protecting lineage and family order. It also denies the adulterer any claim, expressing legal repudiation of illicit sexual relations.
